verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets user-defined automations: busywork tasks are "described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final." It also documents custom categorization rules, high auto-categorization rates from connected feeds, and AI Close agents that reconcile accounts and review transactions. The evidence is mostly marketing headlines, and outputs are gated on human review, so true background autonomy is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of how to configure these automations (triggers, schedules, run history/monitoring), evidence that agents run unattended without user initiation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
